fields.value: Niranjana Shetty is a Mechanical Engineering Graduate, working as SAP EWM Consultant. He has worked 2 Implementation Projects and 2 Run time projects. He is solution-oriented SAP EWM consultant with a keen understanding of industry-specific warehouse logistics and inventory management challenges. He has sound knowledge of the business process and best practices to configure and integrate the SAP EWM module with other functional modules. 5 years of work experience in SAP EWM S/4HANA & EWM 9.5. Good understanding of Business Process related to warehouse processes and other Inventory Management. Demonstrated expertise in analyzing and documenting complex business requirements, Designing and configuring SAP EWM functionalities, and leading successful system implementations. Skilled in integration of SAP EWM with other SAP modules like PP, MM and SD enabling seamless flow of information across the organization. Goods receipt optimization for special cases. Key areas of expertise in Goods Receipt, Deconsolidation, Physical Inventory, Replenishment, Picking/Packing. EWM triggered opportunistic Cross docking for outbound driven process. Strong understanding of broad business process in the supply chain & manufacturing space, existing knowledge of the solutions that support these processes. Knowledge on IDOCS. Effective interpersonal skills with ability to communicate with support personnel at various organization levels. Analyze different testing scenarios and perform testing.
